questions.q:
What is the unit's digit of the sum 1 + 22 + 33 + 44 + 55?

योग 1 + 22 + 33 + 44 + 55 का इकाई का अंक क्या है?
questions.s:
22 = 4; 33 = 27; 44 = 256; 55 = 3125

Sum = 1+ 4 + 27+ 256 + 3125 = 3413

Alternate:

The quicker way to solve questions like this is to know the repetitive tendency of the unit digits of the powers of numbers 1-9.

For example, any power of numbers with unit digits 1, 5 and 6 would always have the unit digit as 1, 5 and 6 itself respectively. Every odd power of number with unit digit 4 would have unit digit as 4 and every even power would have the unit digit as 6. Unit digits of powers of 2 and 3 repeat for every power of 4, i.e., unit digit of 21 is same as 25, unit digit of 22 is same as 26, unit digit of 33 is same as 37 etc.

=> Sum of the unit digits = 1 + 4 + 7 + 6 + 5 = 23 => Unit digit would be 3.

questions.q: 9. How many two digit numbers are there which are divisible by 8?
questions.s:
9.(a)
Two digit number which is divisible by 8 = 16, 24, 40……..96
First term(a) = 16, last term(l) = 96, common difference(d) = 24-16 = 8
l = a+(n-1)d
96 = 16 + (n-1)8
80 = (n-1)8
10 = n-1
n = 11
So, total no of two digit no which is divisible by 8 = 11

(x - 4), (x - 2), x, (x + 2), (x + 4)
⇒ (x - 4)2 + (x - 2)2 + x2 + (x + 2)2 + (x + 4)2 = 233 × 5  
⇒ 5x2 + 40 = 1165
⇒ 5x2 = 1125 ⇒ x = 15
सबसे बड़ी संख्या = 19
सबसे छोटी संख्या = 11
औसत = 15

questions_hin.q_hi: 7. M के किस मान के लिए 58524M, 9 से विभाज्य है?
questions_hin.s_hi:
7.(c)
58524M को 9 से विभाज्य होने के लिए, इसके अंकों का योग यानी 5 + 8 + 5 + 2 + 4 + M = (24 + M) , 9 से विभाज्य होना चाहिए।
⇒ M = 3 चूँकि 24 + 3 = 27, 9 से विभाज्य

questions_hin.q_hi:
The H.C.F and L.C.M of two numbers lying between 25 and 40 are 7 and 140 respectively. Find the smallest number.

25 और 40 के बीच स्थित दो संख्याओं का महत्तम समापवर्तक और लघुत्तम समापवर्त्य क्रमशः 7 और 140 है। सबसे छोटी संख्या ज्ञात कीजिये।
questions_hin.s_hi:
=> H.C.F * L.C.M = Products of numbers

=> 7*140 = product

=> Product = 980

By factoring, we get the numbers between 25 and 40 as 28 and 35. Also, the multiples of 7 between 25 and 40 are 28 and 35.

The numbers are 28, 35

smallest number = 28
